cases.objective: Verify opposite-phase steering at low speeds (v < 60 km/h).
preconditions: Pre1 Set vehicle speed to 50 km/h
actions: Act2 Monitor rear-angle command for 5 cycles
expected_results: Exp1 Rear-angle command = -K₁·δᶠ (opposite phase)
Exp2 K₁ tapers from max at 0 km/h to min at 60 km/h

cases.objective: Validate steering transition blend in 55–65 km/h range.
preconditions: Pre1 Set vehicle speed to 60 km/h
actions: Act2 Monitor rear-angle command for 5 cycles
expected_results: Exp1 Rear-angle uses weighted blend of opposite and same phase steering
Exp2 Weight function w(v) = 1/(1+e^{-α(v–v₀)}) with α=0.23, v₀=60

cases.objective: Validate same-phase steering at high speeds (v > 65 km/h).
preconditions: Pre1 Set vehicle speed to 70 km/h
actions: Act2 Monitor rear-angle command for 5 cycles
expected_results: Exp1 Rear-angle command = +K₂·δᶠ (same phase)
Exp2 K₂ reduces sensitivity at high speeds

cases.objective: Verify closed-loop yaw-rate feedback control.

actions: Act3 Monitor rear-angle adjustment for 5 cycles
expected_results: Exp1 Rear-angle adjusts according to PI controller output Δδᵣ

cases.objective: Validate hysteresis compensation under steady conditions.

expected_results: Exp1 Rear-angle adjusts with hysteresis offset ≤ 0.3°
Exp2 Offset based on δ_cmd_last and δ_meas

cases.objective: Test steady-state steering accuracy.
preconditions: Pre1 Set vehicle speed to 60 km/h
actions: Act2 Monitor rear-angle command vs feedback for 5 cycles
expected_results: Exp1 Rear-angle target - measurement ≤ 0.5°

cases.objective: Validate fail-safe on invalid inputs.

expected_results: Exp1 System enters degraded mode with rear-angle limited to ±1°
Exp2 Invalid input triggers watchdog timeout

cases.objective: Verify CAN communication of rear-angle command.

actions: Act2 Capture CAN traffic for rear-angle command
expected_results: Exp1 Rear-angle command sent on CAN ID 0xF210
Exp2 Scaling: rear_angle = (value * 0.05) + 0°

cases.objective: Test actuator reset on power loss.
preconditions: Pre1 Set vehicle speed to 60 km/h
expected_results: Exp1 Actuator returns to 0° within ≤300 ms
Exp2 System logs reset event and freeze frame

cases.objective: Verify that opposite‑phase rear‑wheel steering is produced correctly at low speed (v < 60 km/h).
preconditions: Front‑wheel angle set to 20° and held constant.
actions: Maintain the vehicle at 10 km/h for 200 ms while keeping the front‑wheel angle at 20°.
expected_results: δr_cmd equals –K1·20° (K1 value at 10 km/h).
δr_cmd is broadcast every 5 ms.
Rear‑wheel angle sensor follows the commanded value within ±0.2°.
The rate of change of δr_cmd does not exceed 30°/s.

cases.objective: Verify the transition‑blend steering command at the upper boundary of the blend zone (v = 60 km/h).
actions: Maintain the vehicle at 60 km/h for 200 ms while keeping the front‑wheel angle at 15°.
expected_results: δr_cmd equals (1‑w)·δr_opp + w·δr_same where w is computed for v = 60 km/h.
δr_cmd is broadcast every 5 ms.
Rear‑wheel angle sensor follows the commanded value within ±0.2°.

cases.objective: Verify same‑phase rear‑wheel steering at high speed (v > 65 km/h).
actions: Maintain the vehicle at 80 km/h for 200 ms while keeping the front‑wheel angle at 10°.
expected_results: δr_cmd equals +K2·10° (K2 value at 80 km/h).
δr_cmd is broadcast every 5 ms.
Rear‑wheel angle sensor follows the commanded value within ±0.2°.

cases.objective: Verify closed‑loop yaw‑rate feedback compensation is added to the steering command.
actions: Apply a constant yaw‑rate of 0.5°/s for 200 ms while maintaining the front‑wheel angle at 10°.
expected_results: r_error = 0.5°/s – r_model is computed.
Δδr is added to δr_cmd so that the resulting δr_cmd is within ±0.2° of the target.
δr_cmd is broadcast every 5 ms.
Rear‑wheel angle sensor follows the commanded value within ±0.2°.

cases.objective: Verify slew‑rate enforcement limits the rate of change of the rear‑wheel command to 30°/s.
actions: Immediately command the front‑wheel angle to 30° and hold for 200 ms.
expected_results: The first δr_cmd sample after 5 ms changes by no more than 30°/s.
Subsequent δr_cmd samples approach the target gradually, respecting the 30°/s limit.
Rear‑wheel angle sensor follows the command within ±0.2°.

cases.objective: Verify that the rear‑wheel command is correctly generated when the vehicle is at the lower boundary of the low‑speed zone (v = 0 km/h).
actions: Maintain the vehicle stationary for 200 ms while keeping the front‑wheel angle at 25°.
expected_results: δr_cmd equals –K1·25° (K1 value at 0 km/h).
δr_cmd is broadcast every 5 ms.
Rear‑wheel angle sensor follows the commanded value within ±0.2°.
The command rate remains below 30°/s.

cases.objective: Verify that rear‑wheel angle sensor data is correctly captured and logged during a steering command.
actions: Maintain the vehicle at 15 km/h for 200 ms while holding the front‑wheel angle at 12°.
expected_results: δr_cmd equals –K1·12° (K1 value at 15 km/h).
δr_cmd is broadcast every 5 ms.
Rear‑wheel angle sensor follows the command within ±0.2°.
All sensor data (speed, angles, yaw‑rate) are logged for post‑test analysis.

cases.objective: Verify that the system correctly enters degraded mode when the rear‑wheel command exceeds the 0.5° error threshold.
actions: Force δr_cmd to 10° while the rear‑wheel sensor remains at 0° for 200 ms.
expected_results: δ_target – δr_meas exceeds 0.5° for more than 50 ms.
DTC C1A27 is stored and the system enters degraded mode.
Rear‑wheel command is limited to the degraded‑mode maximum.
Rear‑wheel sensor continues to read 0°.
postconditions: DTC C1A27 is cleared after the fault condition is removed.
Rear‑wheel sensor returns to normal operation.

cases.objective: Verify that the rear‑wheel steering command is not issued when the rear‑wheel angle sensor is invalid.
preconditions: Rear‑wheel angle sensor reports an invalid value.
actions: Maintain the vehicle at 20 km/h for 200 ms while keeping the front‑wheel angle at 15°.
expected_results: No δr_cmd is generated because the rear‑wheel sensor is invalid.
The system logs a sensor‑validation error.
No steering command is transmitted to the rear‑wheel actuator.
postconditions: Rear‑wheel sensor returns to a valid reading.

cases.objective: Verify that the rear‑wheel steering command is correctly limited when the rear‑wheel angle sensor is stuck at 0° during a high‑speed command.
preconditions: Rear‑wheel angle sensor reports 0° and is stuck.
actions: Apply a constant front‑wheel angle of 10° for 200 ms while the rear‑wheel sensor remains stuck at 0°.
expected_results: The commanded δr_cmd would be +K2·10°, but because the sensor is stuck the error exceeds 0.5° for more than 50 ms.
A DTC C1A27 is stored and the system enters degraded mode.
The rear‑wheel command is limited to the degraded‑mode maximum.
Rear‑wheel sensor continues to read 0°.
postconditions: DTC C1A27 is cleared after the fault condition is resolved.
Rear‑wheel sensor returns to normal operation.
